scenario: LOPQ.5.1 — an opaque value flows like a scalar: it can be carried from a matched fact slot onto an emitted fact's opaque slot. Compiles clean.
rules_ds:
opaque type Key over Bytes

schema In scope logical:
    pubkey: Key key

schema Out scope logical:
    pubkey: Key key

rule r:
    In i
->
    emit Out logical pubkey: i.pubkey
